observations: Photo 0 is a professional stock image of a camera on a white background.
The image has a 'Jiji.ng' watermark in the bottom right corner.
The seller's text is truncated marketing copy, likely copied from a product page.
There are no photos of the actual physical unit being offered for sale.

risks.risk: The photo is a stock image; the actual item's existence is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual camera from multiple angles, including a handwritten note with the seller's name and date.

risks.risk: The functional condition and shutter count are unknown.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on and a screenshot of the shutter count.

risks.risk: The condition of the sensor and lens glass is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor (with lens removed) and the front/rear lens elements.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera and lens being sold, not stock images.
A photo of the camera's screen showing the current shutter count.
A video showing the camera powering on, autofocusing, and taking a picture.
Clear photos of the camera sensor and both ends of the lens glass.
response.reason: The seller has provided only a stock photo and marketing text. I cannot value the item without seeing the actual unit to verify its existence and physical condition.
